comments.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Use the repo’s JS/TS lint command instead of broad `yarn lint`.**

This step can pull in unrelated linters/tasks and increase scope beyond “fix lint/types on PR.” Prefer the repository-guided command for changed JS/TS files.

<details>
<summary>💡 Suggested update</summary>

```diff
-```bash
-yarn lint
-```
+Run JS/TS lint fixes on the files you touched:
+
+```bash
+yarn --cwd code lint:js:cmd <file-relative-to-code-folder> --fix
+```
+
+If you need a broader pass, run it explicitly and mention that it may include non-JS/TS checks.
```
</details>


Based on learnings: "Applies to code/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx} : Lint JavaScript/TypeScript files with `yarn --cwd code lint:js:cmd <file-relative-to-code-folder> --fix` before submitting changes".

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In @.agents/skills/fix-linting-types-on-pr/SKILL.md around lines 40 - 42,
Replace the broad "yarn lint" step with the repository-specific JS/TS lint
command so only changed JS/TS files are fixed: update the instruction that
currently shows `yarn lint` to use the repo command `yarn --cwd code lint:js:cmd
<file-relative-to-code-folder> --fix` (and mention that a broader pass can be
run explicitly if needed); ensure the doc text and the “Applies to” guidance
reference running `yarn --cwd code lint:js:cmd <file-relative-to-code-folder>
--fix` for changed code/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx} files instead of the generic `yarn
lint`.
```

</details>

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The “Fix linting errors” step only runs `yarn lint`, but in this repo that script is a check-only lint (it runs ESLint without `--fix` and `oxfmt --check`). As written, the skill claims to auto-fix linting issues but doesn’t provide a command or process that actually applies fixes. Either update the text to say it *checks* linting and then instruct how to apply fixes (e.g. running formatter and ESLint with `--fix`), or change the command(s) to the repo’s actual fix workflow.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body:
Front matter in other skills includes an `allowed-tools` field (e.g. `.agents/skills/pr/SKILL.md`, `.agents/skills/canary/SKILL.md`). This new skill omits it, which may prevent the agent framework from granting the Bash/Read capabilities needed to run the documented commands and inspect files. Add an appropriate `allowed-tools: ...` entry (likely at least `Bash, Read`) to match the established skill format.
```suggestion
description: Checks out a PR (including fork PRs), fixes all linting and TypeScript errors, then pushes the changes back. Use when asked to fix lint, types, or TS errors on a PR.
allowed-tools: Bash, Read
```

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: This sequence skips from “Step 6” to “Step 8”, which makes the instructions harder to follow and suggests a missing step. Renumber the subsequent headings or add the missing Step 7 (e.g., re-run lint/check after fixes) so the flow is consistent.
